verdict.rationale: Browserbase publishes extensive first-party API docs, an official Node.js SDK, webhook system with signature verification, and session control endpoints (docs-1,4,22,19,20,21), confirmed by a live llms.txt probe describing 'one API key gives your agent everything it needs.' missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s) and independent third-party corroboration of API usage beyond vendor docs.
